oneLine: Permira and TPG Capital acquire stakes in Cloudnine Hospitals for $450 million.

sources.title: Permira, TPG pick up Cloudnine stakes in $450 million deal at $1.3 billion valuation

synopsis: Permira and TPG Capital have acquired stakes in Cloudnine Hospitals from early investors True North and TPG NewQuest in a secondary transaction worth $450 million. The deal values the maternity and childcare chain at about $1.3 billion. Permira acquired True North’s 25% stake in a $250 million transaction, while TPG through its buyout fund bought TPG NewQuest’s holding in a $150-180 million deal. Because the transaction is secondary, no new capital is injected into the company, with proceeds going directly to the selling shareholders. The transaction remains subject to regulatory approvals. Upon completion, Cloudnine plans to prepare for a public listing over a 24-36 month horizon. True North first invested in Cloudnine in 2015, and TPG NewQuest invested in 2021.
